problem: Distinguish an elementary arrow's response to its incident relationships from its response through the full geometric configuration without equating the four relational roles with successive simplices.
source: Retained proton tetrahedral geometry and all twelve labelled directed outer-arrow occurrences; the source coefficient protocol remains separate.
primitive_weight_convention: Each of the twelve directed geometric arrow occurrences carries one resource unit. Opposite orientations remain separate occurrences. This does not assert that the carrier's mass is twelve.

declared_field_realization.coordinates: Six antisymmetric oriented-edge connection coordinates, with an explicit readout to all twelve primitive occurrences.
declared_field_realization.relationships: Four whole-face loop comparisons obtained by summing the source's centroid-triangle boundary chains.
declared_field_realization.curvature: b=C a, retaining all four oriented face entries.
declared_field_realization.metric_rule: M_face(f)=area_reference/area(f), from the norm of a face-averaged flux integrated over its face; the reference area is one source tetrahedral face.
declared_field_realization.response_operator: K=C^T M_face C. This is a declared static curvature-form realization, not the source L/G/N Hamiltonian.
declared_field_realization.local_response: Clamped environment: 1/(s+K_AB,AB). The complete AB row and its incident faces are also retained.
declared_field_realization.collective_response: All edge coordinates free: (K+s I)^(-1)e_AB. Keep the entire six-coordinate response and the full resolvent, not just the AB entry.
declared_field_realization.s: 1 and 2, dimensionless response probes; not physical time, rest offsets or an electromagnetic frequency selection.

bold_conjecture: A change outside AB's incident face geometries, with its local response row fixed, changes its full anchored response.
named_rivals: The arrow is protected by symmetry/cancellation even while the full configuration response operator changes.
A scalar anchored measurement hides a change in the rest of the anchored response packet.
Any apparent collective response change was caused by changing an incident face, not the remote configuration.
risky_consequences: AB, ABC and ABD keep their geometric lengths and areas under a proper hinge of D about AB, whereas CD and the remote faces change.
The primitive registry and unit-resource count remain identical.
The full anchored response differs between configurations while the entire AB operator row agrees.
strongest_falsification_attempt: Use the source's equal incident-face weights first. Test the entire rooted response packet at both probes. If it remains identical, record shielding rather than manufacture sensitivity. Separately use an explicitly labelled unequal-incident-weight control, held fixed across the same geometry pair, to discriminate symmetry protection from a solver defect.
control_weighting: Multiply the ABD face metric by two in both configurations. This is a deliberate constitutive perturbation, not a source-derived mass rule.
